verdict.rationale: Honeycomb Boards provide a shareable workspace for saving and organizing queries, with pre-built Board Templates, addressing the core 'shareable dashboard' need, but the evidence pack shows no mention of rich chart/visualization type variety or template variables (parameterized dashboards) as distinct features. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple visualization/chart types beyond query results, and template variable support for dynamic/parameterized boards, plus independent/hands-on corroboration of the dashboard experience.
